import json, subprocess, sys
MAIN='/workspace/submission/main.py'
def run_raw(data):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',MAIN],input=data,capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode,p.stdout.decode(),p.stderr.decode()
def run(doc): return run_raw(json.dumps(doc).encode())
def msg(start, headers, body=b''):
    text='\r\n'.join([start]+headers)+'\r\n\r\n'
    return (text.encode('latin-1')+body).hex()
def base_cfg():
    return {"accounts":[
        {"id":"alice","default":"sip:alice@lab.test","aliases":["sip:alice@lab.test","sip:desk@lab.test","tel:+12025550100"]},
    ],"peers":[{"id":"edge","mode":"access","accounts":[]}],"ttl_ms":1000,"capacity":10}
def ev(t,peer,auth,egress,wh): return {"t":t,"peer":peer,"auth":auth,"egress":egress,"wire_hex":wh}
REG=base_cfg()
def show(name,doc):
    rc,out,err=run(doc)
    print('====',name,'rc',rc,'out',out[:400] if rc else '')
    if rc==0:
        j=json.loads(out)
        for r in j['results']: print(' ',json.dumps(r))
        print(' ',{k:j[k] for k in ('accepted','replayed','rejected','live')})

def mkfrom(f='sip:alice@lab.test',tag='t'): return f';tag={tag}'
def std(extra=None,body=b'',fromv=None,to='sip:bob@lab.test',cl=None,callid='c',cseq='1',method='MESSAGE',target='sip:bob@lab.test'):
    if fromv is None: fromv=mkfrom()
    if cl is None: cl=str(len(body))
    hs=[f'From: {fromv}',f'To: <{to}>',f'Call-ID: {callid}',f'CSeq: {cseq} {method}',f'Content-Length: {cl}']
    if extra: hs+=extra
    return msg(f'{method} {target} SIP/2.0',hs,body)

# invalid envelopes
print('--- invalid envelope tests ---')
for name,data in [
  ('dup key', b'{"version":1,"version":1,"config":{},"events":[]}'),
  ('nan', b'{"version":NaN,"config":{},"events":[]}'),
  ('bom', b'\xef\xbb\xbf{"version":1}'),
  ('trailing', b'{"version":1,"config":{},"events":[]} x'),
  ('bad utf8', b'{"version":1\x80,"config":{},"events":[]}'),
  ('not json', b'hello'),
]:
    rc,out,err=run_raw(data)
    print(name,'->rc',rc,'stdout_len',len(out))

doc={"version":1,"config":{"accounts":[],"peers":[{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}],"ttl_ms":1,"capacity":1},"events":[{"t":5,"peer":"p","auth":None,"egress":"internal","wire_hex":""},{"t":4,"peer":"p","auth":None,"egress":"internal","wire_hex":""}]}
print('descending time rc', run(doc)[0])
doc2={"version":1,"config":{"accounts":[],"peers":[{"id":"p","mode":"relay","accounts":[]}],"ttl_ms":1,"capacity":1},"events":[{"t":5,"peer":"p","auth":None,"egress":"internal","wire_hex":""}]}
# relay empty ok
print('relay empty rc', run(doc2)[0])
doc3={"version":1,"config":{"accounts":[],"peers":[{"id":"p","mode":"relay","accounts":[]}],"ttl_ms":1,"capacity":1},"events":[{"t":5,"peer":"p","auth":"x","egress":"internal","wire_hex":""}]}
print('relay auth nonnull rc', run(doc3)[0])

print('--- semantics ---')
# display name with quoted '>' and comma; anonymous privacy id
w=std(extra=['Privacy: id'],fromv='"a>b, c" <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>;tag=t')
show('quoted angle display anon id',{"version":1,"config":REG,"events":[ev(0,'edge','alice','internal',w)]})

# folded from tag across lines
w=std(fromv='sip:desk@lab.test')
# build folded manually
w=msg('MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0',['From: sip:desk@lab.test','\t;tag=t','To: <sip:bob@lab.test>','Call-ID: c','CSeq: 1 MESSAGE','Content-Length: 0'])
show('fold from tag',{"version":1,"config":REG,"events":[ev(0,'edge','alice','internal',w)]})

# port + uppercase host target
w=std(target='SIP:bob@LAB.test:005060')
# To must equal target canonical
w=msg('MESSAGE SIP:bob@LAB.test:005060 SIP/2.0',['From: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t','To: <sip:bob@lab.test:5060>','Call-ID: c','CSeq: 1 MESSAGE','Content-Length: 0'])
show('port canonical',{"version":1,"config":REG,"events":[ev(0,'edge','alice','internal',w)]})

# tel from with separators
w=std(fromv='tel:+1-202-555-0100')
show('tel from separators',{"version":1,"config":REG,"events":[ev(0,'edge','alice','internal',w)]})

# PAI two addresses order tel then sip (relay), select sip first
w=std(extra=['P-Asserted-Identity: <tel:+12025550100>, <sip:desk@lab.test>'])
# but relay requires relay peer; use relay config
cfg=base_cfg(); cfg['peers']=[{"id":"edge","mode":"relay","accounts":["alice"]}]
show('relay PAI order tel,sip',{"version":1,"config":cfg,"events":[ev(0,'edge',None,'internal',w)]})

# privacy mix id and none -> fields
w=std(extra=['Privacy: id; none'])
show('privacy mix',{"version":1,"config":REG,"events":[ev(0,'edge','alice','internal',w)]})

# duplicate From header -> headers
w=msg('MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0',['From: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t','From: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t','To: <sip:bob@lab.test>','Call-ID: c','CSeq: 1 MESSAGE','Content-Length: 0'])
show('dup from',{"version":1,"config":REG,"events":[ev(0,'edge','alice','internal',w)]})

# content-length leading zeros
w=std(body=b'abc',cl='0003')
show('cl leading zeros',{"version":1,"config":REG,"events":[ev(0,'edge','alice','internal',w)]})

# body with CRLF and header-like
w=std(body=b'a\r\nBogus: x\r\n\r\n')
show('body crlf',{"version":1,"config":REG,"events":[ev(0,'edge','alice','internal',w)]})

# compact headers
w=msg('MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0',['f: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t','t: <sip:bob@lab.test>','i: c','CSeq: 1 MESSAGE','l: 0'])
show('compact',{"version":1,"config":REG,"events":[ev(0,'edge','alice','internal',w)]})

# expiration + capacity
cfg=base_cfg(); cfg['capacity']=2; cfg['ttl_ms']=10
# events: accept A(t0,callA), accept B(t1,callB), accept C(t2,callC) -> evict A( oldest first=0)
def evcall(t,callid,body=b''):
    return ev(t,'edge','alice','internal',std(callid=callid,body=body))
doc={"version":1,"config":cfg,"events":[evcall(0,'A'),evcall(1,'B'),evcall(2,'C')]}
show('capacity eviction',doc)
